name: ImmoScout24
notes: Largest DE portal; Spandau search pages indexed 2026. Official REST API (api.immobilienscout24.de, OAuth 1.0a, developer account + sandbox; search resource is 2-legged) but positioned for realtors/partners; saved searches with email/push alerts. Third-party scrapers use private mobile API; anti-bot measures reported. Direct fetch blocked from sandbox (proxy 403/DNS); ToS/robots not verified.

name: Immowelt (AVIV Germany)
notes: Operated by AVIV Germany GmbH (renamed from immowelt GmbH Feb 2024; Axel Springer). Single-brand strategy 2026 absorbed Immonet. ~352 Spandau rentals seen in 2026 snapshot. Listing-import API key exists for agents (partner), no public search API found. Email alerts likely but not confirmed in this research. Direct fetch blocked from sandbox (proxy 403/DNS); ToS/robots not verified.

name: Immonet
notes: Merged into immowelt: AVIV announced one-brand strategy Jan 2026 (IZ 3 Feb 2026); trade press (Versicherungsbote, ~Mar 2026) reports immonet.de redirects to immowelt. immonet.de did not resolve from sandbox (Oct 2026). Do not integrate separately.

name: Kleinanzeigen (formerly eBay Kleinanzeigen)
notes: Spandau rental category page indexed. No official public/partner listing API found; datacenter IPs reportedly blocked. Saved-search alerts not confirmed in this research. Direct fetch blocked from sandbox (proxy 403/DNS); ToS/robots not verified.

name: WG-Gesucht
notes: Active (2026 pages incl. 'mietwohnungen-berlin'). Mix of WG rooms, temporary and unlimited flats. No official API found; community crawlers report reCAPTCHA on automated access. Email alerts not confirmed here. Direct fetch blocked from sandbox (proxy 403/DNS); ToS/robots not verified.

name: Wohnungsbörse.net
notes: Active (Mietspiegel pages updated May 2026; 172 Spandau results seen). Impressum names Immobilien Scout GmbH (Berlin) as operator, so listings likely overlap ImmoScout24. 'Suchauftrag anlegen' email alerts. Direct fetch blocked from sandbox (proxy 403/DNS); ToS/robots not verified.

name: ivd24immobilien.de (IVD portal)
notes: Portal of IVD (only IVD-member agents list); ~75k listings in 2018. No 2025/26 evidence of status found; Berlin rental depth unknown.

name: Neubau Kompass
notes: neubau kompass AG (Munich, est. 2008): database of new-build developer projects, mainly for buyers; rental coverage unclear. Site content not retrieved.

name: HousingAnywhere
notes: Mid-term (typically 1-12 months) platform for students/expats; 1,285-3,032 Berlin listings seen; 'Get alerts' button on search pages.

name: Wunderflats
notes: Furnished stays from 1 month; active 2026 (landlord pages, 'Homelike alternative' page). Partnerships handled by contact (e.g. hotelnetsolutions); no public listing API found.

name: Homelike
notes: Cologne furnished-apartment marketplace filed insolvency Jan 2025 and ceased operations end of March 2025 (deutsche-startups.de ticker, 1 Apr 2025). Exclude.

name: Spotahome
notes: Mid-term furnished rentals; active 2026 (Berlin data Oct 2025-Mar 2026, blog posts Jun-Aug 2026). No public API found.

name: Waitly
notes: Waitlist platform (Waitly GmbH, founded 2019) for cooperatives/landlords; blog active Aug 2026 claims sign-up to multiple Berlin/Hamburg coop waitlists with notifications. Which Berlin coops participate not independently verified.

name: WohnAlert
notes: No evidence found of a service by this name (searches Oct 2026). Possibly confused with inberlinwohnen 'Angebotsalarm'. Do not include without a URL.

name: degewo
notes: State-owned. Has Spandau stock & lettings (Senate answers); new build Bismarckstr. 17-19 (122 units, 98 subsidized) due mid-2026. Senate answer: applicants use subscribed Suchaufträge on degewo.de/ImmoScout24; no waitlists. Also listed via inberlinwohnen.

name: GESOBAU
notes: State-owned; 2026 Senate answer: no stock managed in Spandau (focus Pankow/Reinickendorf). Listings via own site/inberlinwohnen.

name: Gewobag
notes: Largest landlord in Spandau: 18,022 units (30.06.2025); ~929-1,012 new lettings/yr there (2023-24). Senate answer: 74,147 active Suchaufträge on its site; also lists on ImmoScout24, Immowelt, immobilien.de, inberlinwohnen. Big Gartenfeld/Waterkant new builds.

name: HOWOGE
notes: State-owned; 386 units in Spandau at 31.12.2025 incl. 231 new builds let from 2026 (Havelufer Quartier). Offers via own site, 'Meine HOWOGE' app, ImmoScout24, inberlinwohnen.

name: STADT UND LAND
notes: State-owned; 2026 Senate answer: no stock in Spandau.

name: WBM
notes: State-owned. Spandau new builds Rauchstraße (BA1 238 units; BA2 111 units letting, move-in from May 2026, 62 WBS at 7 EUR/m2) and Staaken project; a 2026 Senate answer nonetheless says WBM manages no Spandau stock - conflicting.

name: berlinovo
notes: State-owned; mainly furnished apartments, student and state-employee housing (~5,500 units to Landesbeschäftigte; new joint points system 2026). No Spandau specifics found.

name: inberlinwohnen.de (joint portal of state-owned companies)
notes: Bundles offers of the state-owned housing companies (degewo, GESOBAU, Gewobag, HOWOGE, STADT UND LAND, WBM; berlinovo is 7th LWU). 'Angebotsalarm' email via search profile (Berliner Mieterverein, ~2016; current status not re-verified). Best single integration target for public housing. Direct fetch blocked from sandbox (proxy 403/DNS); ToS/robots not verified.

name: Vonovia
notes: Largest private landlord; with Deutsche Wohnen ~140k Berlin units (2026), sold 14,750 to municipal cos in 2025. Spandau holdings exist (tenant reports) but size unknown. Listing page/alert features not confirmed. Expropriation debate in Berlin 2026.

name: Deutsche Wohnen (Vonovia group)
notes: Subsidiary of Vonovia (since 2021), still a separate brand. 2016 data: 2,362 publicly funded units in Spandau. Current listing channel not confirmed.

name: Heimstaden Germany
notes: Owns 484-unit complex at Päwesiner Weg, Spandau (first DE deal) and Berlin ex-Akelius stock; 'Wohnen am Ruhwaldpark' (Spandauer Damm) is in Charlottenburg. Listing page not retrieved.

name: Grand City Properties
notes: ~86k units, significant Berlin share; no Spandau-specific evidence; rental site not retrieved.

name: TAG Wohnen (TAG Immobilien)
notes: ~80k units mostly eastern Germany; only ~300 in central Berlin (2019) plus ex-TLG stock. Rental site not retrieved.

name: DPF eG (Wohnungsbaugenossenschaft DPF Berlin)
notes: Coop founded 1957 (Deutsche Post); ~3,784 units in eastern districts (2009), office Gundelfinger Str. 8a, 10318 Berlin. 'Deutsche Wohnwerte' not found. Website URL not verified.

name: Märkische Scholle Wohnungsunternehmen eG
notes: ~3,668 units in Reinickendorf, Wittenau, Schmargendorf, Wilmersdorf, Schöneberg, Tempelhof, Mariendorf, Lichterfelde (2020); none in Spandau. Membership required.

name: Baugenossenschaft Freie Scholle (Berlin-Tegel)
notes: Founded 1895, >1,500 units exclusively in Reinickendorf (2026 job ad). Website URL not verified; not Bielefeld namesake.

name: IDEAL Wohnungsbaugenossenschaft
notes: No usable evidence found in searches; verify name/URL manually.

name: EVM Berlin eG (Erbbauverein Moabit)
notes: Paulsenstr. 39, 12163 Berlin (Steglitz) per Mieterverein list 12/2021. Spandau stock not confirmed.

name: GEWIWO Berlin Wohnungsbaugenossenschaft
notes: Rathauspromenade 68, 13437 Berlin (Reinickendorf) per Mieterverein list 12/2021. Spandau stock not confirmed.

name: Charlottenburger Baugenossenschaft eG
notes: ~6,700 units; 2,518 in Spandau (Falkenhagener Feld, Hakenfelde, Siemensstadt etc.) per its district page. Membership required.

name: Berliner Bau- und Wohnungsgenossenschaft von 1892 eG
notes: ~7,000 units, Knobelsdorffstr. 96, 14050 Berlin; Spandau listed among its districts in a university presentation (2010), specific estates not confirmed.

name: Berliner Wohnungsgenossenschaft eG 'Nord-Ost 77'
notes: Exact name per directory: Berliner Wohnungsgenossenschaft eG 'Nord-Ost 77', Lea-Grundig-Str. 26, 12679 Berlin; ~917 units in Marzahn/Hohenschönhausen. URL inferred from email domain, not verified.

name: ohne-makler.net
notes: Commission-free portal with Spandau district pages; free email Suchaufträge (frequency 'sofort'). Mostly sales; few Spandau rentals seen.

name: immobilien.de
notes: National portal (Bad Tölz, since 1996); Spandau rentals syndicated to regional newspaper portals; Gewobag lists here (Senate answer).

name: meinestadt.de Immobilien
notes: Free Suchauftrag; disclaimer references immowelt.de as listing source (likely immowelt-fed, so duplicates).

name: Trovit
notes: Metasearch aggregator with Spandau page; snapshot listings appeared stale (late 2025). Duplicates other portals.

name: Nestoria
notes: Berlin pages show '0 Wohnungen mieten' in 2026 search snapshots - likely no longer populated. Exclude unless re-verified.

name: Wohnglück.de
notes: Portal with Suchauftrag service; Wilhelmstadt (Spandau) listing seen.

name: Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften Berlin (wohnungsbaugenossenschaften.de)
notes: Marketing initiative of Berlin cooperatives; 2018 flyer lists member coops by Ortsteil incl. Haselhorst, Siemensstadt, Spandau, Staaken. Useful directory; live listing search not confirmed.

name: Wohnungsbaugenossenschaft Gartenstadt Staaken eG
notes: Founded 1913, heritage-listed estate in Staaken; Am Heideberg 12, 13591 Berlin (ortsdienst directory). Unit count/website not verified.

name: Wohnbau-Genossenschaft Groß-Berlin eG
notes: Listed in ortsdienst directory near Falkenhagener Feld (Spandau); stock location not confirmed.

name: Bau- und Siedlungsgenossenschaft Postheimstätte eG
notes: Berlin coop (active 2026 job ads); listed in directory near Falkenhagener Feld; Spandau stock not confirmed.

name: Baugenossenschaft 'Vaterland' eG
notes: Founded 1920, Alboinstr. 33, 12103 (Tempelhof); appears in 2018 coop flyer alongside Spandau Ortsteile; Spandau stock not confirmed.

name: 'Baugenossenschaft Spandau' / 'Wohnungsbaugenossenschaft Spandau'
notes: No evidence of a coop by this name found. Senate data: ~5,500 coop units in Spandau overall (2014).

name: Covivio (Germany residential)
notes: >17,000 Berlin units (2022); 552-unit portfolio acquired 2023 includes Spandau assets. Listing page not retrieved.

name: ADLER Group
notes: Refocused on Berlin rentals (Feb 2026), ~18-26k units; Spandau share unknown; possible sale discussed 2025.

name: Hilfswerk-Siedlung GmbH (Evangelisches Wohnungsunternehmen)
notes: Church housing company managing ~10,000 own/third-party units in Berlin/Brandenburg (HRB 5011). Spandau stock not confirmed; URL from 2016 press contact.
